## What I checked, by focus area

**Auth and identity**
- Preview and send share one guard: `requireAppAccess`, then `authorizeReviewerRequestMutation` inside `withDalContext`, before any reminder content loads (`pages/api/review-manager/send-review-reminder.js:71,100-107`).
- The preference owner for GET, PUT and DELETE is `actorRefFromSession` (`pages/api/review-manager/reminder-email-preferences.js:35`), which reads `session.user.dynamicsSystemuserId` and never request input (`lib/utils/actor-ref.js:71-76`).
- Reads and writes go through `findByOwnerAndKey` with that id (`lib/services/reviewer-reminder-personalization.js:77,100,115`), bypassing the profile remap.
- The generic preference route blocks both keys on single-key GET, strips them from the list GET, and rejects POST and DELETE (`pages/api/user-preferences.js:24-38,102,115,138,192`).

**Preview proof-to-send**
- The digest binds actor, request, suggestion, kind, canonical `{subject, body}`, row ETag, both due dates, title, sender id and mailbox, recipient, reviewer name and signature (`lib/services/reviewer-manual-reminder.js:330-345`).
- Send recomputes the digest from fresh reads and verifies signature, expiry, single audience and single op (`reviewer-manual-reminder.js:418-419`; `reviewer-reminder-personalization.js:137-145`). The `subject` alias maps to `sub` at `lib/services/external-token.js:261`.
- The proof is not single-use. A replay after a claim is still blocked, because the claim changes the row ETag and `expectedEtag` is rechecked at claim time (`reviewer-manual-reminder.js:197,431`).
- Preview and send render through the same builders with the same inputs.
